New
- Three ways to unlock: Nura Solo (£7, this one device), Nura Screens (£15, up to 5 TVs) and Nura Family (£20, 1 PC, 5 TVs and 2 phones).
- Your profile shows your playlist's first letter instead of a flag.
- Licence key full? Nura lists the devices on it and you choose which one to switch off.
- About this programme in the programme menu, and a Compact guide option in Settings > General.

Fixed
- The licence key box works with the remote: press Down to reach Activate.
